machine: cloud container, 4 CPU, no GPU; torch CPU, 2 threads
command: scripts/train_assoc.py train --no-saas (shipped) / train (variant with SaaS), both --out to the scratchpad, then copied
choice: Ship the variant without the SaaS pairs: it has the better held-out AUC on both truth-labelled sources (synthetic seeds 8-9: 0.9952 vs 0.9908; held-out Lottie: 0.9916 vs 0.9878). The variant with SaaS scores higher only against the SaaS video-derived labels (0.977 vs 0.909), which agree with truth at 0.9035 but with precision 0.636 and recall 0.726 for 'same' on the training synthetic and Lottie clips: noisy labels.
rho_curve: ECC-label agreement with truth is flat from rho 0.05 to 0.65 (0.9035; 0.8551 at 0): the mask-coverage condition decides, not the correlation, which is either high or 0 (ECC non-convergence).

shipped.sources: synthetic kinds (seeds 2-7 train, 8-9 held), LottieFiles free animations (Lottie Simple License), gold mk571 (Mixkit free)

variant_with_saas.sources: synthetic kinds (seeds 2-7 train, 8-9 held), LottieFiles free animations (Lottie Simple License), gold mk571 (Mixkit free), Envato Elements SaaS previews (paid templates; previews never committed)
